user.title: Culligan account
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the Culligan Connect app.

data_description.email: The email address of your Culligan Connect app account.

data_description.password: The new password for the same Culligan Connect account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Culligan
reconfigure.description: Sign in again, or switch to a different Culligan account.

data_description.email: The email address of your Culligan Connect app account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Culligan API.
error.no_devices: Sign-in worked but no devices are registered to this account.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.another_account: Those credentials are for a different account. Add it as a new entry instead.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often to poll the Culligan cloud. A softener changes state slowly; short intervals add load to an undocumented API for no benefit.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Culligan cloud, in seconds. The default is deliberately gentle: this is an undocumented third-party API and a softener changes slowly.
data_description.force_capabilities_on: Hardware this softener has that was not detected automatically. Detection reads a group as present as soon as any of its datapoints reports a non-zero value, so this is only needed for a unit whose hardware reports nothing but is genuinely fitted.
data_description.force_capabilities_off: Hardware to hide even if detected. Takes precedence over 'Always show'.

not_loaded.message: Culligan is not loaded, so this action cannot run.

unknown_serial.message: No configured Culligan device with serial {serial}.

auth_failed.message: Culligan rejected the stored credentials ({error}); re-authentication has been started.

bypass_timed.name: Bypass for a duration
bypass_timed.description: Bypass the softener for a fixed number of minutes, after which it returns to softening automatically. While bypassed the house receives UNSOFTENED water.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes. The app offers 30, 60, 90, 120 or 180; other values are accepted by the API but unverified on hardware.

set_clock.name: Sync controller clock
set_clock.description: Set the valve controller's clock to Home Assistant's current local time. The controller keeps its own clock, separate from the wifi module's NTP-synced one, and nothing syncs it automatically. The change is not visible until the device next powers up.
